What changes for plugin users, and why:

- [ ] A test covers the change. A bug fix has a test that fails without it.
- [ ] `npm run check` passes, and `dist/` is rebuilt with `npm run build` when `src/` changed.
- [ ] A change to recall or the hooks passes the performance gates, and `docs/evaluation.md` has the `npm run eval` numbers that moved.
- [ ] README or `docs/` describe the change, and `CHANGELOG.md` has a line for a change users notice.
